stem: Which of the following best describes Eric's main conflict in the story?

options.label: F
options.text: He does not know the names of the customers who frequently eat at his parents' deli.

options.label: G
options.text: He thinks his parents need to offer a better variety of sandwiches at the deli.

options.label: H
options.text: He has to help his parents on a day that he has plans with his friends.

options.label: J
options.text: He is bothered by the lack of excitement in his parents' deli.
